answer: I'd like to talk about the piece of technology I reach for more often than anything else. A piece of technology I find genuinely useful is my smartphone, which has become an extension of my daily life. I know that is a fairly obvious choice, but its sheer [[versatility]] is remarkable. It functions as my alarm, camera, map, bank and library all in one device. At work, I use it constantly to reply to students' messages, check university deadlines and join video calls with admissions officers abroad. In the evenings, I use it to read e-books, listen to music or video-call my elder sister and her children in Dhaka. I learned to use it intuitively, simply by exploring its features over time. Nobody really taught me; I just experimented, made a few mistakes and occasionally watched a short tutorial when I got stuck. Funnily enough, I've now become the person my parents turn to whenever their own phones misbehave. What makes it so useful is how it [[consolidates]] dozens of tasks that once required separate tools. It has made my life significantly more [[efficient]], allowing me to work, communicate and organise on the move. Of course, I am aware there is a downside; it can be quite [[addictive]] if you are not careful. Still, used sensibly, it is an incredibly powerful tool. Honestly, it is hard to imagine how people managed everyday tasks before smartphones existed. I think it is a perfect example of how technology has become deeply [[embedded]] in modern life, for better or worse, and I would struggle to function without mine.

followUps.q: Do you think you use your smartphone too much?
followUps.answer: Probably, yes, especially in the evenings. I've started leaving it in another room while I read, which helps me [[switch off]] properly and makes that time feel far more restful.

followUps.q: Is there any other technology you find useful?
followUps.answer: My laptop, definitely. For long documents and university applications at work, a phone just isn't enough, so the two complement each other rather well and I use both every day.
